waybackify search [flags] <original-url>

CDX capture query — re-pick a better capture

CDX capture query (the library's getSnapshot/getSnapshots face) — for
re-picking a better capture when check flags one bad. No
date-anchoring cleverness: --near passes through, default is
CDX's own ordering.

Output: JSONL, {timestamp, statuscode, mimetype, waybackUrl} per
capture.

Arguments:
  <original-url>   the archived-site URL to query captures of

Flags:
  --near <ts>      preferred timestamp (YYYYMMDD[HHMMSS]); passed through to CDX
  --limit <n>      maximum captures to emit
  --help|-h        Show help

part of the wayback.charlie.dev mirror tooling
